name: How can I prepare my home for a kitchen remodel?

mainEntity.name: How can I prepare my home for a kitchen remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before your kitchen remodel begins, you should clear out all cabinets and drawers, find a temporary spot for essential kitchen items, and secure any valuables. Protect adjacent areas with dust sheets or plastic barriers, and consider setting up a temporary cooking station if you'll be without your kitchen for an extended period. Discuss specific preparation steps with your contractor to ensure a smooth start to the project.
acceptedAnswer.description: Prepare your home by clearing cabinets, securing valuables, and protecting adjacent areas. Discuss specific preparation steps with your contractor.
